paragraphs: From Cavalon follow the path on the mission map east then north. The chest is located in the southwest corner of Maishang Hills, point 1 on the mission map. sections.heading: Initial dialogue
paragraphs: Elder Rhea "You have proven yourself a capable and loyal ally of the Luxons, so it is with confidence that I impart on you this most vital mission. You have, of course, seen how important the great turtles are to us, both as beasts of burden and beasts of war. Unfortunately, a group of bandits have recently attacked one of our supply caravans and stolen a chest of turtle eggs before they could reach the hatchery. Our turtles are very rare, and it is not often that they lay eggs, so every single egg is precious to us. We must track the bandits back to their camp in the Maishang Hills, recover the chest of turtle eggs, and get them to the Gyala Hatchery before something happens to them. Can you do this for us, <Character name>?"

Accept: "Hang on, little ones! I'll save you!" Decline: "Have you ever tried pickled turtle eggs?" Ask: "I have heard that the bandits make their camp in Maishang Hills. They are sure to have the eggs there. Once you find them, get them back to Hatchery Keeper Gratian as quickly as you can."

sections.heading: Reward dialogue

Until I see you fight with my own eyes, your strength is nothing to me...Words on the wind. If we make it to the end of this alive, then your reputation with myself, and the rest of the Luxons, will be solid as this sea of jade."

sections.heading: Notes
paragraphs: Stsou Swiftscale will not spawn if the quest Attack the Kurzicks! is active. It is possible to run this quest without attacking any foes.

Quest information[edit]

Objectives[edit]

  • Recover the stolen chest of turtle eggs.
  • Return the chest of turtle eggs to Hatchery Keeper Gratian.
  • See Endre for your reward.

Reward[edit]

  • 4,000 Experience
  • 1,250 Luxon Faction
  • 150 Gold
  • 1 Skill Point

Walkthrough[edit]

From Cavalon follow the path on the mission map east then north. The chest is located in the southwest corner of Maishang Hills, point 1 on the mission map. Sergeant Rodrik and the Outcast crew will start a conversation once you get close, and soon will become hostile and attack. After the fight is over, grab the chest and follow the path marked on the mission map. After crossing the bridge at point 2, you will need to turn almost 180 degrees to the left and take the path heading south. Take the chest to Gyala Hatchery which is in the southeast corner of the same territory. The Kappa and Naga you encounter along this path are quite strong so come prepared. Also as you approach the beach at the end, you will run into a group of Naga which includes Stsou Swiftscale.

The chest is a bundle item, which provides no blessing of any kind, but does not interfere with movement speed.

Our turtles are very rare, and it is not often that they lay eggs, so every single egg is precious to us. We must track the bandits back to their camp in the Maishang Hills, recover the chest of turtle eggs, and get them to the Gyala Hatchery before something happens to them. Can you do this for us, <Character name>?"

 Ask: "I have heard that the bandits make their camp in Maishang Hills. They are sure to have the eggs there. Once you find them, get them back to Hatchery Keeper Gratian as quickly as you can."

Reward dialogue[edit]

Endre
"So you are the ones coming along with us. Argo told me about you. You may have beaten the three clans at the Convocation, but I was not witness to it. Until I see you fight with my own eyes, your strength is nothing to me...Words on the wind. If we make it to the end of this alive, then your reputation with myself, and the rest of the Luxons, will be solid as this sea of jade."
